aboutStore.description:
Matarangi is a relaxed coastal town on the northeastern side of the Coromandel Peninsula, known for its long, safe beach and laid-back holiday vibe.


The beach at Matarangi stretches for kilometres, with soft white sand and gentle surf -perfect for swimming, paddleboarding, and family days by the water. It’s also a popular spot for fishing, especially off the beach, nearby estuaries or out into the deep blue ocean.


Golf lovers will appreciate the stunning The Dunes Matarangi Golf Club, an 18-hole championship course set between the harbour and the ocean. Designed by New Zealand legend Sir Bob Charles, it features rolling fairways, coastal views, and a layout that challenges all skill levels while still being enjoyable for casual players.


The town itself has a friendly, close-knit feel, with a local Four Square, cafés, and everything you need for an easy beach getaway without the crowds.


Matarangi is ideal if you’re after a peaceful coastal escape - perfect for relaxing, exploring, fishing, golfing, and soaking up the best of the Coromandel coast.
